{
  "decision-dryer-probe-swap-evidence": "SELECT n.dryer_code, CASE WHEN (b.inlet_c > b.outlet_c) <> (a.inlet_c > a.outlet_c) THEN 'follows_probe' ELSE 'stays_at_socket' END AS pattern, n.source_id
FROM swap_notes AS n
JOIN socket_checks AS b ON b.dryer_code = n.dryer_code AND b.tick_min = n.before_tick
JOIN socket_checks AS a ON a.dryer_code = n.dryer_code AND a.tick_min = n.after_tick
WHERE ABS(b.inlet_c - b.outlet_c) >= 4 AND ABS(a.inlet_c - a.outlet_c) >= 4
ORDER BY n.dryer_code COLLATE BINARY, n.source_id COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-earliest-journey-with-transfer": "SELECT a.leg_id AS first_leg, b.leg_id AS second_leg, b.arrive_min AS arrival_min
FROM legs AS a
JOIN legs AS b ON b.origin = a.destination AND b.depart_min >= a.arrive_min + 8
WHERE a.origin = 'Grove' AND a.depart_min >= 480 AND a.destination NOT IN ('Grove', 'Quay') AND b.destination = 'Quay'
ORDER BY b.arrive_min, a.leg_id COLLATE BINARY, b.leg_id COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-early-payout-funding-selection": "WITH ready AS (
  SELECT offer_code, draw_cents, fee_cents FROM payout_offers WHERE ready_flag = 1
), choices(selected_codes, funded_cents, earned_cents) AS (
  SELECT '', 0, 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT offer_code, draw_cents, fee_cents FROM ready
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.offer_code || ',' || b.offer_code, a.draw_cents + b.draw_cents, a.fee_cents + b.fee_cents
  FROM ready AS a JOIN ready AS b ON a.offer_code COLLATE BINARY < b.offer_code
)
SELECT selected_codes, funded_cents, earned_cents FROM choices
WHERE funded_cents <= (SELECT available_cents FROM cash_limits)
ORDER BY earned_cents DESC, funded_cents ASC, selected_codes COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-effective-reserve-true-up": "WITH balances AS (
  SELECT c.merchant_code, c.close_day, n.source_id, c.held_cents, n.ceiling_cents, (c.exposure_cents / 10000) * n.rate_bps + ((c.exposure_cents % 10000) * n.rate_bps) / 10000 AS uncapped_cents
  FROM reserve_closes AS c
  JOIN reserve_notices AS n ON n.rowid = (
    SELECT r.rowid FROM reserve_notices AS r
    WHERE r.merchant_code = c.merchant_code AND r.starts_on <= c.close_day
    ORDER BY r.starts_on DESC, r.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
  )
)
SELECT merchant_code, close_day, source_id, (CASE WHEN uncapped_cents > ceiling_cents THEN ceiling_cents ELSE uncapped_cents END) - held_cents AS posting_cents
FROM balances
ORDER BY merchant_code, close_day"
}
